facebook.text:
Your link is the brief.

Instead of rebuilding the idea on a blank canvas in Canva or Adobe Express, paste the page link and let the content guide the design. Poaster turns that one input into square, story, and wide graphics together, with your saved colors, fonts, and logo applied automatically. Link to on-brand graphics in seconds. The leftover time goes to reviewing the message instead of adjusting layouts.

Swipe for the four-slide version. poaster.co, 3 downloads free before you create an account.
